statement: A legitimately admitted fresh seed completes protected activation, durably transfers its original registration and cluster-identity rights, and reaches normal service through the supported startup path.

constraints.statement: Child of raft-rs-full-cutover by owner decision 2 of 2026-10-26 (solve/epics/raft-rs-full-cutover/evidence/owner-review-2026-10-26/OWNER-REVIEW-2026-10-26.md). Not an amendment of retained-seed-original-handoff: that sealed Quest ends HANDOFF_COMPLETE_SERVING_DEFERRED by design and this Quest neither restates, widens nor satisfies its claim or receipts.

Only the live original issuer (preparation opening mode LIVE_ISSUER, set by prepare() in this process) may start elections, and only for openings admitted under its exact allocation. The decision replaces the unconditional throw in assertOriginalSeedContinuation (src/bootstrap/seed-original-allocation-startup.js) with one decision of the preparation owner keyed on its mode; COLD_RECOVERY, a null mode and any other state keep the hold exactly as today.

Registration consumes each original SERVICES birth right and the anchor's reserved cluster-identity right UNUSED -> SUBMITTED durably before its single submission, and SUBMITTED -> TRANSFERRED only after an exact authoritative committed same-value read. A missing answer, timeout or absence never resets a right or re-arms the INSERT. The rights-transition writer is transitionOriginalRight or its owner-defined successor; WHERE it lives is decided by the lifecycle-owner correction Q3 with the Q4 census witness, and this Quest consumes that decision rather than re-deriving it.

Public admission (BootstrapAPI readiness, the transport WebSocket listener and external transport admission) opens only after every declared right is TRANSFERRED; internal activation is narrowly authorized and grants no public effect. One startup admission decision is consumed by the existing ingress owners; no listener, ready snapshot or completed phase grants it.

Retained, partial, uncertain and cold mid-handoff states keep their protections: the retained classification hold, the directory-custody refusal, the authority refusal, native entry only by the exact opening, and COLD_RECOVERY never silently authorized. No fixture, default or double in src supplies an owner. Existing sealed witnesses (seed-original-attempt-lifetime, raft-rs-original-*, retained-seed-original-handoff) are not weakened.

The restart on the same durable data is measured and reported as served or as an owner-named typed hold. This Quest makes no recovery claim: two-start, retained-handoff and cold mid-handoff obligations remain with retained-seed-original-handoff and the final cutover acceptance. Reports distinguish harness defects resolved, startup assertions still blocked by a hold, and fresh-seed acceptance demonstrated.

Proof is the witness test/bootstrap/fresh-seed-activation.integration.test.js through actual startLagrangeRuntime in genuinely new child processes, consuming owner fixtures only, recorded into the receipt by a quest-evidence writer on canonical lab execution with retries 0. Source changes need an independent approving verification newer than the last attempt. No deadline, assertion, baseline or ratchet relaxation.
